title: Plant Distillation Profiles for Folio Matching

axis_definitions.ITERATION: Distillation passes, cohobation, redistillation (0=single pass, 5=many cycles)
axis_definitions.STRUCTURAL: Apparatus complexity, physical intervention (0=basic pot, 5=sealed retort/vacuum)

plants.name: lavender
plants.rationale: Standard steam distillation, moderate temp, single pass, obvious endpoint.

plants.name: rose
plants.rationale: Cohobation mandatory (75% oil in distillate water). Multiple redistillation passes, careful fraction collection.

plants.name: chamomile
plants.rationale: Temperature-sensitive azulene compounds. Standard steam but needs thermal care.

plants.name: ylang_ylang
plants.rationale: 20+ hours, 5 commercial grades (Extra/I/II/III/Complete). Florentine vessel changed every 15 min. Most complex endpoint management.

plants.name: jasmine
plants.rationale: Heat-destroyed; requires solvent extraction or enfleurage. Specialized apparatus, multiple washes.

plants.name: neroli
plants.rationale: Delicate orange blossom. Good yield but temperature-sensitive linalool/linalyl acetate.

plants.name: violet
plants.rationale: Like jasmine, heat-destroyed. Solvent extraction/enfleurage only. Very low yield.

plants.name: helichrysum
plants.rationale: Standard steam, robust plant material. Monitoring needed for optimal chemical profile.

plants.name: peppermint
plants.rationale: Simplest common distillation. High yield, robust, fast, minimal apparatus. Very flexible timing.

plants.name: rosemary
plants.rationale: Standard steam but often vacuum-fractional for chemotype separation. Multiple quality grades.

plants.name: thyme
plants.rationale: Temperature-sensitive thymol/carvacrol ratio. Standard steam, single pass.

plants.name: sage
plants.rationale: Standard steam distillation. Robust, good yield, straightforward.

plants.name: basil
plants.rationale: Standard steam or hydrodistillation. Moderate difficulty, good yield.

plants.name: lemongrass
plants.rationale: Channeling risk in packed bed. PLC monitoring recommended. Moderate complexity.

plants.name: melissa
plants.rationale: Extremely low yield (0.01-0.02%). Long distillation, temperature-sensitive citral. Often requires redistillation.

plants.name: bay_laurel
plants.rationale: Standard steam distillation of dried leaves. Moderate difficulty.

plants.name: vetiver
plants.rationale: 14-36h continuous steam at high pressure. Dense root mass needs sustained energy. Temperature-critical for sesquiterpene quality.

plants.name: valerian
plants.rationale: Root distillation requires more energy than leaf/flower. Standard steam, moderate difficulty.

plants.name: angelica_root
plants.rationale: Dense root, long distillation. Multiple chemical fractions of interest. Careful monitoring.

plants.name: orris
plants.rationale: 3-6 years root aging required before extraction. Extremely rigid protocol. Low yield, specialized process.

plants.name: cinnamon_bark
plants.rationale: Bark needs water-steam method. Moderate energy for woody material. Straightforward endpoint.

plants.name: cassia
plants.rationale: Higher yield than true cinnamon, more robust. Standard steam, less temperature-sensitive.

plants.name: birch_bark
plants.rationale: Dry distillation (pyrolysis) at 340-420C in sealed oxygen-depleted retort. Extreme energy, specialized sealed apparatus.

plants.name: frankincense
plants.rationale: Resin requires crushing and long steam exposure. Monitoring needed to avoid overheating terpenes.

plants.name: myrrh
plants.rationale: Similar to frankincense. Resin needs sustained steam. Careful thermal management.

plants.name: mastic
plants.rationale: May require superheated steam. Specialized apparatus for resin processing.

plants.name: anise
plants.rationale: Robust seed distillation. High anethole yield, straightforward process.

plants.name: fennel
plants.rationale: Very similar to anise. Seed distillation, straightforward. Longer duration for full extraction.

plants.name: coriander
plants.rationale: Seed crushing needed. Moderate temperature sensitivity for linalool preservation.

plants.name: orange_peel
plants.rationale: Cold pressing preferred (no heat). If steam distilled, careful monitoring of limonene degradation.

plants.name: lemon_peel
plants.rationale: Almost always cold-pressed. Zero heat, simplest apparatus, very flexible timing.

plants.name: juniper_berry
plants.rationale: Berry crushing required. Standard steam, moderate complexity.

plants.name: sandalwood
plants.rationale: 14-72h continuous high-pressure steam. Highest energy demand. Absolutely rigid timing. Heartwood must be soaked and finely ground.

plants.name: cedarwood
plants.rationale: Dense wood needs sustained high energy. Robust — tolerant of temperature variation. Simple endpoint.

plants.name: rosewood
plants.rationale: Dense tropical hardwood. Long high-energy steam. Linalool-sensitive requires some thermal care.
